messages:
rachel: FYI from the quarterly least-priv audit: found 5 svcaccts with cross-env cloudkms.decrypter on a shared keyring. some show last-used >200d.

 tom: can you paste the quick query so SRE can reproduce?

 rachel: quick BigQuery snippet we ran against the cloudaudit export:

 ```sql
 SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS principal,
        resourceName,
        COUNT(*) as hits
 FROM `redwood-audit.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_*`
 WHERE protoPayload.serviceName='cloudkms.googleapis.com'
   AND TIMESTAMP(protoPayload.timestamp) > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 180 DAY)
 GROUP BY principal, resourceName
 HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
 ```

 tom: ok. propose a minimal-risk plan: 1) snapshot key IAM policy 2) pick 1 non-prod svcacct as canary 3) apply conditional binding or remove and monitor 24h 4) roll in batches.

 rachel: snapshot command and storage:

 ```bash
 gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/shared/cryptoKeys/master-key > pre-policy-${thread_ts}.json
 gsutil cp pre-policy-${thread_ts}.json gs://redwood-audit/kms-snapshots/${thread_ts}/pre-policy.json
 ```

 ops-bot: ticket created: KMS-4512 owner=tom due=2026-04-10.

 tom: monitoring signals: cloudkms AccessDenied by principal, job failures referencing decrypt errors, and elevated pager counts. thresholds for canary: >2 AccessDenied in 30m OR >3 job failures in 24h => rollback.

 rachel: rollback add command if triggered:

 ```bash
 gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding projects/PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/shared/cryptoKeys/master-key \
   --member='serviceAccount:svc-canary@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \
   --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter'
 ```

 tom: prefer conditional binding during test to reduce blast radius. example condition: request.time < timestamp("2026-04-15T00:00:00Z").

 rachel: compliance wants a 3-line justification per revoke. draft: 1) pre-policy path (gs://redwood-audit/kms-snapshots/${thread_ts}/pre-policy.json) 2) observed risk: cross-env key exposure/unused principals 3) mitigation: rebind to per-pipeline keys + rotate master.

 audit-bot: snapshot recorded at gs://redwood-audit/kms-snapshots/3600011223/pre-policy.json by rachel.

 tom: action items: TOM run canary + post logs; RACHEL finalize justification and update ticket; ops-bot will schedule phased rollout after canary green. target decision 2026-04-05 EOD.

 rachel: i'll run canary 09:00 PT tomorrow against svc-canary and paste greps here (keeping thread for audit evidence).
